unitree.bulk_exclusion_reason: ObjectPlacement ep 0 is the corpus minimum at 49 frames (1.6 s at 30 Hz) and fails conversion with `ValueError: need at least one array to stack`; excluded so the corpus-wide sweep completes. Re-include only together with a root-cause fix.

fruits.note: archived pilot only; excluded from processed conversion
fruits.bulk_conversion_reason: Human review rejected this dataset for training conversion: the recorded whole-body trajectory stays crouched and free SONIC walks backward while following the reference. Keep raw data and pilot evidence archived.

apple.note: whole-body 64D pilot; measured observation.state hands are diagnostic only, not action labels
apple.bulk_conversion_reason: Body labels come from action_t but the only radian hand values are observation.state_t. Their command mapping and action-to-state latency are unverified, so a mixed 78D label is not valid VLA supervision.
